title: helianthemum guttatum var. plantagineum
intro: Helianthemum guttatum var. plantagineum, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a perennial shrub native to the Iberian Peninsula, characterized by its pink or purple flowers and woody stems. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, wounds, and skin conditions, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose include soothing and calming effects, making it useful in the treatment of anxiety, insomnia, and other stress-related disorders. Bioactive constituents of Helianthemum guttatum var. plantagineum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
